## Type of change

<!-- Tick everything that applies. -->

- [ ] `fix` — a bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — a new feature
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no change in behaviour
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `chore` / `package` — build, tooling, dependencies
- [ ] **Settings change** — the app's own settings file, `studio.darudb`, holds something new or something different
